$comment: Wave 5 lane T's sibling table (the wave 5 base, plans/parallel_build_tk.md section 7c): the sbx kit per agent. `name` is sbx's built-in agent (`from: sbx`) or a kit reference from docker/sbx-kits-contrib (`from: sbx-kits-contrib`), which sbx create takes as its first positional argument (sbx 0.51.0 deprecates a sandbox kit passed with --kit; plans/parallel/tk_sbx_smoke.md, SB1). null where neither sbx nor sbx-kits-contrib has a kit for the agent (read 4 Nov 2026 at sbx-kits-contrib 1de3c1e). Every kit read starts its agent in its own full-access mode where the agent has one, and none carries derm's gate: under sbx the VM is the boundary and the in-harness gate is absent (lane T, SB6). presets.rs and contracts/presets.ts merge each value into its row as `kit`. Shape: contracts/harness-presets.schema.json, $defs.kit. run/harness.rs still holds the kits derm run uses today (PI_KIT); reading this table there is lane T's request T-2.
